d: A small group of survivors are left behind after millions of people suddenly vanish and the world is plunged into chaos and destruction.

When aliens have infiltrated society by inhabiting bodies of select human beings, they plan a full-scale invasion of Earth. A detective finds the information that can stop the attack; however the information is in the mind of a six-year-old child.
Travelling home, four soldiers discover a village gripped by fear, as residents are abducted by unknown predators. These warriors set out to rescue them and destroy what lurks outside the village.
Five young people find themselves stranded in Moscow, fighting to survive in the wake of a devastating alien attack.
When evil screams throughout the world. When all the galaxies converge. When all that's fair and fine seems lost. A Hero will emerge.
